description: A pulsar oscillator: a short waveform is played once per cycle and the rest of the cycle is silence, which sets the pitch apart from the colour

params.text: Sets the pitch, -8 to 4 as a power of two around middle C, which is about 1Hz to 4186Hz
Shifts the pitch by up to a hundred cents either way
Sets how much of each cycle the waveform fills, 0 to 0.99; the shorter it is the higher the colour it gives the sound
Attenuates the voltage at the Duty jack before it is added to the Duty knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets how many pulses are packed into each cycle, 1 to 8
Sets the waveform played in each pulse, 0 to 3, moving smoothly from sine through triangle and square to saw
Attenuates the voltage at the Waveform jack before it is added to the Waveform knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Picks the envelope each pulse is shaped by: Rect, Ramp, Decay, Gauss or Triangle
Shapes the chosen envelope, 1 to 10; what it changes depends on which envelope is chosen

inputs.text: Sets the pitch by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
Modulates the duty, a fifth per volt scaled by the D CV knob
Modulates the waveform, three tenths per volt scaled by the Waveform CV knob
Sets the number of pulses by voltage in place of the knob, 1V to 10V, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets the envelope by voltage in place of the knob, one volt per setting from 0V for Rect to 4V for Triangle, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets that shaping by voltage in place of the knob, 1V to 10V, and moves the knob while it is patched

notes: the wave is worked out sixteen times over per sample and filtered, which keeps the short pulses from aliasing

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1.99V.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 3V.
inputs.3:
1 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Cluster knob.
inputs.4:
0 to 4V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the envelope knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.5:
1 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the envelope shaping knob.
